verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Cloudflare offers a 'globally distributed key-value' store (cloudflare-docs-4) and a separate Queues service (cloudflare-docs-9), and community mentions 'KV storage' (cloudflare-comm-3), but nothing indicates Workers KV is Redis-protocol-compatible or usable as a Redis substitute for caching/job-queue patterns. Missing for 10: any claim or documentation of Redis API/protocol compatibility, benchmarks showing low-latency Redis-like semantics, or job-queue patterns built directly on the KV store.
